responsibility: Implementation file for RTL SSA instruction-movement legality checks. In this module it supplies the out-of-line predicate can_move_insn_p, which classifies whether an insn_info is fundamentally movable at all by rejecting control-flow instructions and potentially trapping RTL patterns. It belongs to the instruction scheduling/transformation support around movement.h and provides the basic safety gate consumed before the more detailed SSA range and dependency-based movement restrictions are applied.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the single out-of-line implementation companion to movement.h: it only defines can_move_insn_p, the basic movability predicate that rejects control-flow and trapping insns. Unlike gcc/rtl-ssa/movement.h, it does not provide the inline range-adjustment and dependency-based movement restriction utilities used to compute where an insn may move within an EBB.
